title: Dependency declared with the GitLab shorthand
description: package.json declares the `gitlab:` dependency shorthand. The shorthand resolves from a forge the registry never vetted and follows a moving reference, so the packaged bytes are not the reviewed bytes.
remediation: Publish the artifact with a version and integrity, or pin the shorthand to a commit sha.
limitation: It matches the `gitlab:` dependency shorthand in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
